title: Silicon SoC Architect
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact
As a Principal Engineer specializing in Silicon SoC Architecture at Intel, you will be at the forefront of designing and driving next-generation System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures that define the future of datacenter and agentic computing. This is a role of strategic importance, where your expertise will shape the technological direction of Intel and influence the industry at large. You will lead the end-to-end architecture and development of modular, scalable, and highly optimized SoCs that serve the needs of diverse segments, from high-performance computing to ultra-low power solutions. By innovating new architectural approaches and mentoring other technical leaders, you will play a pivotal role in delivering leadership solutions that power the world's most impactful technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and develop end-to-end SoC architectures, including hardware, firmware, and functional specifications, to meet connectivity, configuration, performance, timing, power, and area goals.
  • Drive the evaluation, integration, and optimization of existing IP blocks into new SoCs, defining gaskets or glue logic as necessary.
  • Explore and implement novel architectural features for next-generation products, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable designs.
  • Develop, execute, and analyze tests, test plans, and testing infrastructure to validate new architectures and features, using advanced statistics and data analysis to benchmark performance and identify improvements.
  • Collaborate with architects, design engineers, system engineers, and verification engineers to ensure seamless SoC design and address development constraints.
  • Review and influence cross-functional roadmaps, define technology targets, and contribute to the long-term innovation strategy for future SoCs.
  • Act as a domain expert, providing technical leadership across the organization and the industry.
  • Mentor and develop other technical leaders while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence in alignment with Intel's core values.
  • Deep expertise in SoC architecture development methodologies, system architecture, and microarchitecture.
  • Proven experience in defining architecture features, registers specifications, and SoC development.
  • Proficiency in computer architecture fundamentals, CPU architecture, and systems thinking.
  • Demonstrated ability in problem solving and evaluating feasibility tradeoffs to drive SoC optimization.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of experience. OR
  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years of experience. OR
  • PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 6+ years of experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of innovation, including conceptualizing and specifying advanced microarchitectures for future products.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and contributing to technical strategies.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills to develop leadership within the organization.
  • Expertise in benchmarking, performance analysis, and advanced statistical modeling.
  • Knowledge of emerging trends and technologies in computing, with a strategic vision for the evolution of SoC architectures.

title: CPU Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join Intel's Silicon Engineering Group as a CPU Design Verification Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the functional accuracy and performance of next-generation processor designs.

In this role, you will collaborate with architects, RTL developers, and physical design teams to verify and validate cutting-edge CPU architectures that power millions of devices globally. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative solutions, refine industry-leading methodologies, and shape the future of computing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans to validate CPU logic against architectural specifications

  • Build scalable UVM-based testbenches and define robust functional coverage models

  • Run system-level simulations to uncover design bugs and ensure functional integrity

  • Debug and root-cause issues in the pre-silicon environment; implement corrective measures to resolve test failures

  • Collaborate closely with CPU architects and RTL designers to verify complex architectural and microarchitectural features

  • Maintain and improve existing verification infrastructure, methodologies, and flow automation

  • Document verification strategies and lead technical reviews with design and architecture teams

  • Contribute to the definition and refinement of CPU architecture and microarchitecture features to meet functional, performance, and power goals

Take the next step in your career by joining a team where your contributions make a global impact. Apply today and help Intel engineer the future of technology.

  • Degrees in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field

  • Strong expertise in SystemVerilog for developing UVM-based testbenches

title: EHS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact
As an Environmental Health and Safety Engineer, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding the health and safety of employees, the community, and the workplace environment. On a day-to-day basis, you will lead the development, implementation, and management of safety programs, conduct workplace hazard assessments, and ensure adherence to health and safety regulations and Intel standards. Your expertise will drive compliance, mitigate risks, and foster a safe and sustainable work environment that supports Intel's operational excellence.

Business group
This role is part of Intel's Environmental Health and Safety organization, which focuses on creating and maintaining safe and sustainable workplace environments across Intel's global operations. The team is dedicated to ensuring regulatory compliance, minimizing environmental impacts, and fostering a culture of safety and wellbeing. By supporting Intel's broader goals, this group plays an integral role in advancing responsible and sustainable business practices.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and manage industrial hygiene and safety programs to ensure compliance with local, regional, and Intel standards.
- Conduct workplace hazard evaluations to recognize, evaluate, and control potential risks.
- Investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and create corrective action plans to prevent future occurrences.
- Monitor workplace environments and assess environmental factors or stresses that could impact employee health or community wellbeing.
- Maintain accurate records of employee exposure to hazardous waste and pollutants as required.
- Prepare and deliver training programs focused on workplace safety and hazard prevention.
- Stay updated on changes to EHS regulations and industry practices to ensure ongoing compliance and best practices.
- Provide industrial hygiene and safety support for process equipment procurement by reviewing/validating supplier equipment meets SEMI S2 and S8, semiconductor industry standards.
- Provide industrial hygiene and safety design support for equipment and facilities installations in partnership with factory stakeholders.
- Provide industrial hygiene and safety technical support for foundry process technologies including new introduction of chemicals or new process equipment.
- Conduct high quality and detailed risk assessment for manufacturing equipment and facilities. Provide appropriate recommendations for health and safety controls, engineering and/or administrative, to address identified risks.
- Collaborate with EHS TFSM module owners to enable health and safety improvements in Intel's factories.
- Support health and safety cross site teams as the Ocotillo site representative.

 The successful candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits:
- Demonstrates ability to effectively interpret and communicate health and safety requirements to promote a safe and healthy workplace.
- Demonstrates application of sound engineering principles and technical problem solving.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Proactively communicates strategic and tactical concepts across a wide range of employees.
- Effectively collaborates with business partners to understand operational plans in order to anticipate health and safety issues and proactively resolve them.
- Effectively contributes within a team environment.

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, engineering or other relevant sciences with 4+ years of professional experience in EHS management in the same field.

At least 3 years of experience in:
- Proficiency in workplace hazard evaluation techniques.
- Strong knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks and standards related to EHS.
- Conducting incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, engineering or other relevant sciences with 4 plus years of experience with conducting field assessments, technical analysis and communicating requirements within industrial hygiene and safety disciplines.
- Experience with conducting exposure assessments, chemical evaluations, job hazard analysis, process hazard analysis, and other technical analysis.
- Experience working in semiconductor manufacturing, other advanced manufacturing and/or technology development.
- Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor teams, fostering a culture of safety and compliance.
- Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify and address EHS challenges effectively.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate across teams and engage employees in safety initiatives.
- Experience in leading cross-functional safety programs and driving continuous improvement in EHS practices.
- Passion for promoting a safe and sustainable workplace environment.
- Certified Industrial Hygienist and / or Certified Safety Professional.

We invite you to bring your expertise and passion for industrial hygiene and safety to Intel, where you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and contribute to a workplace that values safety and sustainability.

title: Wireless Connectivity System and Architecture Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel is a leading technology company specializing in cutting-edge wireless communication solutions. We are seeking a highly motivated Wireless Connectivity System Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role you will primarily own system-level integration, validation, and optimization of wireless connectivity SoCs and platforms, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and related technologies, while also contributing to the system architecture and definition of next-generation products. You will work at the intersection of hardware, firmware, software, and architecture, driving issues from early bring-up through production readiness, and feeding real-world integration and debug insights back into system specifications, architectural trade-offs, and future product definition.

Key Responsibilities:

System and Architect

  • Lead and contribute to end-to-end system integration of wireless connectivity SoCs and platforms.
  • Drive silicon bring-up, feature enablement, and system readiness across development milestones.
  • Contribute to the definition of the system architecture of wireless SoC products, considering power efficiency, performance, and scalability.
  • Integrate wireless IPs across HW, FW, driver, and OS layers to ensure correct system behavior.
  • Translate integration and validation learnings into architectural improvements and next-generation product definition.

Debug, Validation & Root Cause Analysis

  • Perform system-level debugging of complex issues spanning analog, digital, firmware, and software domains.
  • Develop and execute validation strategies, test plans, and stress scenarios to ensure product quality and robustness.
  • Conduct deep root cause analysis and drive fixes across cross-functional teams.
  • Leverage AI/ML-based tools and data analytics to accelerate log analysis, anomaly detection, and automated failure triage.

Performance, Power & Reliability Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize performance, latency, throughput, power consumption, and coexistence behavior at the system level.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, ensuring the SoC meets stringent performance requirements.
  • Support trade-off decisions between features, power, performance, and schedule.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with architecture, design, firmware, software, validation, and product teams to align system requirements and resolve integration challenges.
  • Act as a technical focal point for system-level wireless connectivity topics.

Documentation & Technical Leadership

  • Produce clear technical documentation, integration guidelines, design guidelines, and issue reports.
  • Present findings and recommendations to engineering and management stakeholders.
  • Contribute to process improvements and best practices for system integration, validation, and architecture.
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve debug, validation, and documentation efficiency.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Experience in system integration or system validation of complex SoC-based products. Exposure to system architecture, system definition, or specification work for SoC or wireless products. Strong understanding of wireless connectivity technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, coexistence – advantage). Hands-on experience with debug tools, lab equipment, and system-level validation environments. Familiarity with semiconductor technologies and SoC development processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment. Working proficiency with Python / scripting and AI-GenAI tools to automate data analysis, debug, and validation flows. Experience applying AI / machine learning techniques to log analysis, anomaly detection, or automated failure triage. Hands-on use of GenAI / LLM-based assistants for code, test, and documentation generation. Familiarity with AI/ML acceleration and on-device inference considerations in SoC architecture.

Preferred Qualifications (Advantage)

Experience with wireless SoC bring-up or post-silicon validation. Experience defining system architecture or system specifications for wireless products. In-depth knowledge of wireless communication protocols and standards. Familiarity with firmware, drivers, or low-level software. Understanding of power management, performance analysis, and system trade-offs. Experience with system-level modelling and simulation. Experience working across multiple product generations or platforms.

If you are passionate about wireless technology, enjoy solving complex system-level problems hands-on, and want to influence the architecture of future wireless SoCs, we encourage you to apply for this position at Intel. Join us in shaping the future of wireless communication solutions.

title: Senior ASIC DFT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join us to help build the next generation of AI hardware solutions. You will be part of a highly skilled, agile team developing cutting-edge hardware for the AI domain, where we push the boundaries of what silicon can do for emerging AI workloads.

We are building this team from scratch within Intel. With a startup-like culture, we move quickly and give engineers the opportunity to drive significant technical and business impact.
We are intentional, fast adopters of AI as a working tool, and actively use AI throughout our architecture, design, verification, and development workflows.

If you are energized by defining things that have never existed before, value rigorous thinking, and want real scope and short feedback loops, you'll feel right at home here.

This is a senior, hands-on role with broad technical influence.

You will own central DFT aspects in our new family of chips and will define their architecture, planning and implementation. You'll also play a central role at defining and improving the methodologies and workflows we adopt as a team.

Responsibilities

  • Define DFT architecture and strategy for complex AI acceleration IPs and subsystems, balancing test coverage, area, timing, and power.
  • Build the DFT implementation - scan, compression, boundary scan (JTAG), MBIST, and test access/control - and drive fault coverage closure to sign-off.
  • Lead ATPG & pattern generation
  • Contribute to the development of DFT methodologies and working flows, helping drive best practices across the team.
  • Champion and advance the team's use of AI tools across the DFT flow, finding where they add real leverage and helping the team adopt them well
  • Collaborate closely with design, verification, physical design, and product/test engineering teams, and support silicon bring-up, debug, and yield/quality analysis.

Qualifications:

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
  • 6+ years of hands-on DFT experience, with a strong record of driving DFT solutions from architecture through silicon bring-up.
  • Deep command of core DFT techniques: scan insertion, compression, ATPG, boundary scan (JTAG), and MBIST.
  • Strong intuition for working with AI tools and real interest in using them to advance the DFT flow.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex DFT solutions and the ability to drive technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

Advantage

  • DFT experience on large, high-performance, or AI/ML accelerator designs.
  • Hierarchical DFT, low-power test, in-system test, or silicon debug/bring-up experience.
  • Strong familiarity with the broader development cycle, including design, verification, and physical design

title: Security Hardware Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join us to help build the next generation of AI hardware solutions. You will be part of a team developing cutting-edge HW for the AI domain, where we push the boundaries of what silicon can do for emerging AI workloads.

We are continuously developing modern and effective working methods, including hands-on adoption of AI tools throughout the chip development flow. The environment is fast-paced and intellectually stimulating. 

Your Mission: Integrate hardware security IP into the SoC/die and define the HW security architecture protecting a large-scale data center's compute, network, and control infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

  • Integrate third-party and internal HW security IP (Root of Trust, crypto engines, HSMs, TRNG, key vaults) into the die; write and own the RTL/integration code wiring these units into the SoC.
  • Author RTL for security units, glue logic, fuse/OTP interfaces, and bus/fabric (AXI/AHB/NoC) connections; manage clock/reset/power domains and CDC.
  • Develop integration test benches, run lint/CDC/synthesis-readiness checks, and support DV/verification of the embedded security IP.
  • Architect platform Root of Trust, secure boot, attestation, and confidential computing (TDX/SGX/SEV-equivalent) across the server fleet.
  • Threat-model the full stack (silicon, firmware, BMC, supply chain) and define HW mitigations against physical and side-channel attacks.
  • Drive secure key management, debug-lockdown, fuse provisioning, and crypto offload for tenant isolation at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, design verification, physical design, firmware, and platform teams throughout the development cycle.

Qualifications:

  • B.Sc., M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in RTL development, SoC design, or hardware security integration.
  • Proficient in Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL, IP integration, bus protocols (AXI/AHB/NoC); lint, CDC, synthesis, DV flows.
  • Expertise in roots of trust, TEEs, secure boot/firmware, crypto IP, side-channel mitigations.
  • Plus: fuse/OTP provisioning, supply-chain security, multi-tenant cloud isolation.

As a Staff Device Modeling Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing circuit simulation and modeling capabilities for next-generation semiconductor technologies. descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join Intel and build a better tomorrow. Intel is in the midst of an exciting transformation, with a vision to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth. Our high-volume manufacturing facility in Chandler, Arizona is looking for amazing talent. Join and help us create the next generation of technologies that will shape the future for decades to come.

The Ocotillo Technology Fabrication (OTF) DSIRE (Diffusion) Module Engineer role is multifaceted. The ideal candidate will have a passion for instrumentation and equipment with the goal of developing a robust manufacturable process module.

As an OTF DSIRE (Diffusion) Module Engineer you will play an important role in the OTF engineering team. You will be responsible for owning all aspects of one or more of the factory's 300mm toolsets. Your sustaining responsibilities will include the safety and cleanliness of your area and ensuring Copy Exactly for your toolset. You will also be expected to review the relevant control charts and tool output daily and ensure your toolset and layers remain excursion free. You will be responsible for delivering Model of Record (MOR) availability and achieving 100 percent matching for all relevant operations. For new technology start-ups, you will be responsible for tool installations, conversions, and qualifications; and sustained matching performance. You will be expected to drive continuous improvement in the health and matching of your toolset(s) by maintaining and driving an improvement roadmap. You will be responsible for leading your tools and area to achieve record tool availability, cycle time, and record low defect densities in support of OTFs factory goals. OTF supports a High-Volume Manufacturing. As such, your role may include elements of module-level process development in support of the factory's goal and output.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Define roadmaps to meet requirements, goals and milestones for a new technology process.
  • Defines and establishes flow, procedures, and equipment configuration for the module.
  • Selects and develops material and equipment for the process to meet quality, yield, reliability, cost, productivity and manufacturability requirements
  • Plans and conducts experiments to fully characterize the process throughout the development cycle.
  • Drives improvements on quality, yield, reliability, process stability, productivity and safety/ergonomic over variables such as material, method, equipment, environment and operating personnel.
  • Develops solutions to problems utilizing formal education, statistical knowledge, and problem-solving tools.
  • Establishes process control systems for the process module and sustains the module through volume ramp.
  • Develops strategy to resolve difficult problems and establishes systems to deal with these problems in the future.
  • Trains production/receiving process engineers for transfer to other factories.
  • Transfers process to high volume manufacturing and provide support in new factory start-up as well as install and qualification of the new production lines.
  • Position may require working on a day or night shift as an OSE (on-shift engineer) to support toolset needs.

In addition to the qualifications a successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Working in a high performing team culture which includes setting high expectations.
  • Driving accountability to those expectations with a high sense of urgency.
  • Role modeling the desired culture. Possess teamwork and leadership skills.
  • Problem solving and prioritization skills.
  • Driving high performance maintenance goals for the group.
  • Use data to influence factory and virtual factory direction.
  • Listening, written and verbal communication.
  • Deal with ambiguity in defining activities and direction.
  • Commitment to task. Work across organizational boundaries including process engineering, integration and yield.

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Position Summary

Intel IT is a global organization delivering connectivity services across manufacturing and foundry environments, campus spaces, cloud services, and corporate services, seeking a Senior Network Operations Engineer for an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of global network operations.
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on actively engaging in technical details, operational issues, and execution barriers across Intel's global network footprint. This engineer will help ensure the quality, reliability, uptime, and operational readiness of the network services that enable Intel's business, while raising the standard of operational execution, service reliability, accountability, and future-ready network operations.
The role will focus on improving incident response, change quality, operational readiness, root cause follow-through, documentation, monitoring, and execution consistency across network operations teams. This person will also help lead the global operational deployment of new engineering-released network products, ensuring new capabilities are supportable, well-documented, monitored, and ready for reliable execution at scale.
The successful candidate will bring strong enterprise networking experience, practical operational judgment, and the ability to lead cross-functional improvements across globally distributed teams. This role is intended for someone who is viewed as a technical leader today and has the potential to grow into formal leadership or management responsibilities in the future.

________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
• Provide senior technical leadership across global network operations teams, helping improve execution quality, accountability, and operational discipline.
• Drive improvements in incident management, problem management, change quality, operational readiness, service reliability, and root cause follow-through.
• Lead through influence across operations teams, engineering teams, architecture teams, service owners, vendors, and business stakeholders.

• Help define operational expectations for network services across enterprise, manufacturing, campus, lab, data center, wireless, WAN, and related infrastructure environments.
• Partner with automation, monitoring, and tools teams to improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and increase operational consistency.
• Communicate technical risks, operational gaps, service health concerns, and improvement plans clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 10+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, network engineering, infrastructure operations, or technical service reliability roles.

• Experience supporting mission-critical network environments with high availability, reliability, and business continuity expectations.
• Strong understanding of incident, problem, change, request, and service management processes.
• Demonstrated ability to lead technical improvements across teams through influence, technical credibility, and structured execution.
• Experience driving root cause analysis, corrective action plans, operational standards, and continuous improvement.
• Experience supporting or leading operational introduction of new network products, platforms, or engineering releases into production environments.
• Strong technical troubleshooting skills and ability to guide complex issue resolution across multiple teams and technologies.
• Experience improving operational execution through metrics, process discipline, documentation, standards, and service health reviews.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues, risks, and recovery plans to both technical and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting global enterprise networks, manufacturing environments, labs, campuses, data centers, or other mission-critical infrastructure.
• Experience improving operational maturity across globally distributed teams.
• Experience with service reliability practices, ITIL, operational excellence, Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methods.
• Experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, automation, or AI-enabled operations capabilities.
• Experience creating or improving runbooks, operational standards, escalation guides, support models, and service readiness criteria.
• Experience working with managed service providers, vendors, telecommunications providers, or outsourced support teams.
• Experience mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and raising team execution standards.
• Advanced networking certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent experience.

Behavioral Traits

• Strong ownership mindset.
• High standards for operational quality.

• Strong accountability and technical credibility.

title: Compiler Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.


Join Us in Shaping the Future
At Intel, we are building the next generation of software innovation through the oneAPI software stack, a unified programming model designed to unlock the full potential of heterogeneous computing. Our team is at the forefront of enabling developers worldwide to harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators with cutting-edge tools, libraries, and compilers. By joining us, you'll contribute to an open ecosystem that drives performance, scalability, and portability across diverse architectures-empowering breakthroughs in AI, HPC, and beyond. If you're passionate about transforming how the world computes and want to work on technology that truly matters, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

The Team
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team is a high performing team responsible for the industry-leading LLVM-based Intel C, C++, SYCL, and Fortran Compilers. The team consists of leaders in the LLVM community. We are continually pushing the boundaries of compiler technology in support of providing maximally useful and performant compilers for all of Intel's processor platforms, both CPU and GPUs.

We are hiring a Compiler Engineer to work on Intel's open-source compiler stack. You will work on the development of new features that will enable the latest language standards. This work will enable you to collaborate upstream with the members of the clang open-source community, collaborating industry wide to deliver the best solutions. This role is perfect for individuals who thrive on diving deep into complex problems and collaborating broadly when needed. Curiosity is a must.

title: Packaging Module Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

We are seeking a highly motivated, self-driven individual to join Materials Technology Development (MTD), bringing a strong technical background and a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams to drive materials technology development for advanced packaging. The ideal candidate will have a strong educational foundation in Materials Science, such as Metallurgy or Polymer Science or Polymer Chemistry, with an excellent understanding of structure-property-performance correlations in materials and strong functional knowledge of materials characterization tools and techniques.

The candidate must be able to apply sound technical problem-solving skills to resolve materials-process-equipment challenges in technology development and drive innovative materials solutions for advanced packaging at Intel. This role requires close collaboration with cross organizational stakeholders to deliver novel materials technologies that meet stringent quality and reliability requirements. The candidate must also be able to work effectively with external materials suppliers and possess strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to formulate and present materials strategies and development plans in both internal and external forums

Note: This role requires regular onsite presence to fulfill essential job responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develops assembly materials, processes and/or equipment and applies novel concepts for innovative solutions to enable Intel's roadmap of future assembly packaging platform technologies.

  • Optimizes and improves the efficiency of manufacturing of packages, developing innovative materials, processes to meet quality, reliability, cost, yield, productivity and manufacturability requirements.

  • Develops process and equipment specifications applying principles for design of experiments and data analysis, and documents improvements through white papers.

  • Develops materials target specifications to ensure excellent integration of materials into packaging equipment and processes meeting quality and reliability targets.

  • Ensures manufacturability of physical layout of package design and oversees the cycle of manufactured package processes, procedures and flows.

  • Establishes material specifications for contract assemblers and raw material vendors and interfaces with supplier quality and procurement teams to ensure materials technology, quality and vendor performance requirements are met through strict adherence to process specifications and existing product qualification methods.

  • Develops new techniques and acceleration methods, tools, and quality screens to ensure the early identification of potential problems with packaging materials quality and reliability.

  • Sets reliability requirements to meet customer needs and influences design, material selection and process development to meet those needs, based on fundamental understanding of failure mechanisms.

  • Leads efforts towards innovating, problem solving, developing, and continuously improving materials, equipment and processes using experimental design and statistical methods.

  • Provides consultation concerning packaging problems and improvements in the packaging process, and responds to customer/client requests or events as they occur.

  • Delivers standardization in product qualification, manufacturing quality systems, and methods and continuously engages with packaging technology development and partner engineering groups on materials/process/technology maturity for products towards key risk areas in meeting product milestones.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of experience or  Master's degree with 3+ years of experience or Ph.D in a relevant field such as Materials Science, Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in packaging module development, process characterization, or equipment optimization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and manufacturing operations to achieve shared goals.

  • Proficiency in Design of Experiments (DOE) principles and statistical data analysis tools.

  • Demonstrated expertise in packaging fundamentals, package design and development, and package testing methodologies.

title: WPM C4 Quality and Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As a world's leading chip manufacturer, Intel strives to make every facet of semiconductor manufacturing state-of-the-art. From semiconductor process development and manufacturing, through yield improvement to final test and optimization, and lastly advanced die prep and packaging. Employees in Intel Foundry are part of a worldwide network of manufacturing, advanced packaging, and assembly/test facilities.

As a Quality and Reliability Engineer (QRE), you will be part of FQRL (Foundry Quality, Reliability, and Labs), Intel's Quality and Reliability organization. We are strong believers in partnership, collaboration and teamwork. You will routinely work with the fab module engineers, process integration[RB1.1] and worldwide employees both internal and external to Intel. This is an on-site role that requires living in Oregon. This role requires evening meetings most work days.

The Wafer Packaging Manufacturing (WPM) organization owns a crucial part of semiconductor wafer processing, testing, and die-to-wafer assembly. In addition to traditional product types, we drive Intel's advanced packaging strategy - bringing compelling capabilities to market and enabling large-scale AI computing. C4 (bumping) QREs cover several critical process segments[RB2.1] such as interposer, micro-logical, and package side bumping in the WPM organization.

Your key deliverables will include:
• Manage customer quality (both internal and external) issues on products.
• Extract and Analyze data to support risk assessment of suspect/non-conforming material.
• Support and engage with down-stream partners to manage excursions, down-stream investigations, and respond to issues.
• Partnering with other organizations to proactively drive improvements in quality and reliability performance.
• Ensure that the metrics and goals for the end-of-line-hold operations are met, as well as MRB (Material Review Board) [RB3.1]inventory.
• Identify and drive activities and projects to improve detection and containment of potentially discrepant or unreliable material.
• Support Certification and Ramp of new technologies from on-site and off-site development teams.
• 24x7 on-call response (as part of an engineering rotation) to respond to urgent line issues, excursions, or to support task force-level projects.

The ideal candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits:
• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
• Experience in manufacturing environments or familiarity with high-volume production processes.
• A growth mindset and active interest in continuous learning and development.
• Make technical decisions and provide technical direction.
• Evidence of organizational and planning skills for engineering projects.
• Demonstrate effective communication up and down the organization, including skills to communicate technical issues and status to factory and program leadership.
• Effectively work in a highly networked, cross organization role.
• Exhibit strong team building and influencing skills.
• Work under pressure, and in an ever-changing and dynamic environment

title: SoC Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

About the Team:

You will be joining Intel's cutting-edge product development group, a team focused on designing and verifying advanced semiconductor solutions. This group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering high-quality, scalable products that drive Intel's leadership in technology and performance. By contributing your skills here, you will help shape the future of computing and enable groundbreaking advancements in the industry.

Position Overview:

As a SoC Design Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Intel's complex System-on-Chip (SoC) designs meet functional specifications and deliver high-quality performance. You will design scalable and reusable verification plans, develop test environments, and execute tests to uncover issues and improve functionality. Your contributions will directly enhance Intel's product quality and ensure optimal performance in presilicon development.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and update UVM-based test bench generation and test case creation

  • Define and develop scalable and reusable block, subsystem, and SoC verification plans

  • Create test benches and verification environments that align with microarchitecture specifications

  • Execute verification plans, including emulation and system simulation models, to ensure design functionality and uncover bugs

  • Debug and root cause issues in presilicon environments, implementing corrective measures to address failures

  • Collaborate with architects, RTL developers, postsilicon teams, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural features

  • Document and maintain test plans, driving technical reviews with design and architecture teams

  • Integrate security coverage activities within test plans, including regression and debug tests

  • Maintain and improve existing functional verification infrastructure and methodologies

  • Absorb learnings from postsilicon development and incorporate feedback into improved verification strategies.

To Be Successful, You Should Demonstrate the Following:

  • Ability to work collaboratively across interdisciplinary teams

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across interdisciplinary teams

  • Passion for tackling complex problems and delivering innovative solutions

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 7+ years of hands-on experience in SoC design verification, including demonstrated expertise in OVM/UVM methodologies, debugging, and test planning

    OR

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in SoC design verification, including demonstrated expertise in OVM/UVM methodologies, debugging, and test planning.

  • Familiarity with emulation models and system simulation tools for performance analysis

title: Ocotillo Failure Analysis Technician – TEM Prep
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.

As a Product Failure Analysis Technician, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and analyzing electrical, thermal, mechanical, package, or component failures within our products. In this role, you will perform TEM sample preparation and lab operations using state-of-the-art failure analysis tools. You will work closely with engineers to enable high-quality TEM analysis by preparing precise, site-specific samples and maintaining strong lab execution.
This is an excellent opportunity for early-career candidates to gain hands-on experience in semiconductor failure analysis, advanced microscopy techniques, and high-volume lab operations.

Business group
You will join a dynamic team within Intel's manufacturing and engineering organization, where the focus is on driving innovation, ensuring product reliability, and enhancing operational efficiency. This group plays an essential role in advancing Intel's mission to deliver cutting-edge technologies that power the modern world. By analyzing product performance and identifying solutions to improve overall quality, the team helps support Intel's commitment to delivering industry-leading products.

Key Responsibilities
• Prepare TEM samples using Dual Beam FIB/PFIB and related techniques for site-specific analysis
• Operate lab tools including SEM, FIB/PFIB, and optical imaging systems for material analysis and sample prep
• Perform wafer handling, coating, and pre-treatment processes to support TEM workflows
• Execute sample fabrication steps based on schematics, layouts, and engineering instructions
• Partner with engineers and analysts to ensure samples meet quality and turnaround expectations

title: Foundry Device Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation that shapes the future of computing, connectivity, and artificial intelligence. Intel Foundry is Intel's externally facing foundry business, committed to delivering world-class semiconductor manufacturing solutions to a broad and growing customer base. With cutting-edge facilities across the United States and globally, Intel Foundry is uniquely positioned to serve the next generation of chip design companies and technology leaders.

The Manufacturing Development and Customer Engineering (MDCE) organization serves as the critical bridge between advanced technology development and scalable, high-volume manufacturing. MDCE ensures that innovative semiconductor solutions can be successfully produced and delivered to foundry customers — reliably, efficiently, and at scale.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CMOS Device Technologist to join the MDCE Device team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing and customizing semiconductor technologies for high-volume manufacturing, with a focus on general-purpose logic CMOS technologies. Your work will support a broad spectrum of products and markets, including high-performance compute, mobile, mixed signal, memory controllers, and other diverse applications.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to directly contribute to the advancement of Intel Foundry's semiconductor solutions, working alongside world-class engineers to push the boundaries of device performance, power efficiency, and technology scaling. Whether you are based in Hillsboro, Oregon, Chandler, Arizona, or Santa Clara, California, you will be part of a globally connected, mission-driven team.

  • Drive the development and implementation of customized semiconductor device technologies, ensuring compatibility with Intel's existing manufacturing processes and platforms

  • Leverage data analysis, scripting, and analytical techniques to accelerate learning cycles and resolve process and manufacturing challenges

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

About the Group

Intel Foundry is Intel's dedicated foundry organization, providing world-class semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, and systems foundry capabilities to external customers. Intel Foundry plays a central role in Intel's strategy by delivering leading-edge process technologies, manufacturing excellence, and a robust ecosystem of partnerships to fabless and integrated device manufacturers worldwide.

Operating on a global scale, Intel Foundry is focused on enabling customer success through reliable execution, technology leadership, and long-term strategic collaboration.

About the Role

Intel Foundry is seeking a highly collaborative, influential, and experienced professional for a high-impact role that bridges business strategy, market intelligence, technology planning, and customer engagement. This position will play a critical role in shaping Intel Foundry's competitive positioning, driving revenue growth, expanding market share, and identifying new opportunities across the rapidly evolving semiconductor industry.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing Intel Foundry's mid- and long-term business and growth strategies, including three- to five-year growth roadmaps and longer-term strategic planning. This includes conducting comprehensive market and competitive assessments, identifying customer needs and pain points, evaluating growth opportunities, supporting technology investment decisions, and influencing product and technology roadmaps.

A key focus of the role will be developing strategies to expand Intel Foundry's presence with strategic semiconductor customers and increase technology adoption, market penetration, and revenue. The individual will also help determine how Intel Foundry can maximize the commercial value and longevity of its existing technologies and manufacturing capabilities while improving profitability and competitive positioning.

The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams across Research and Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Finance, Planning, and Operations to ensure business strategies are aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, operational capabilities, and corporate objectives.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive semiconductor industry experience, strong business and strategic acumen, exceptional analytical and creative problem-solving skills, and the ability to develop and communicate complex strategies to executive and technical audiences. Experience in semiconductor corporate strategy, business planning, foundry, manufacturing, or fabless semiconductor organizations is highly relevant to this role.

We are looking for motivated graduate candidates who are interested in platform performance engineering for AI server platforms. In this role, you will learn and contribute to GPU-as-an-I/O-device performance validation and optimization, working across CPU host architecture, I/O subsystems, GPU device interactions, and server-level performance analysis. This role is designed for graduate candidates who want to grow into platform performance engineers. title: Senior CPU RTL Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone.

Life at Intel


We developed the Intel microprocessors, a foundational technology that powers a diverse range of devices-from entry-level PCs to high-end gaming desktops and laptops, as well as data center solutions and many other applications. As part of our team, you will help design the next generation of high-performance microprocessors. We are looking for a skilled individual who is hands-on with RTL implementation for integer, floating point and reservation station logic and can provide technical leadership to deliver world-class products.

As a CPU RTL Logic Design Engineer your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
• Collaborates, drives and develops logic design, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulation for a CPU required to generate cell libraries, functional units, and the CPU IP block for integration in full chip designs.
• Participates actively in the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features of the CPU being designed.

title: Partner Marketing Strategist - AI ISV
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel's Partner Marketing team is expanding. We are looking for a strategic, high-energy Partner Marketing Strategist to lead co-marketing initiatives with our world-class AI ecosystem partners, emerging Neoclouds, and AI Independent Software Vendors (ISVs).


In this role, you won't just be managing traditional marketing campaigns. You will champion a solution-selling approach, bridging the gap between Intel's cutting-edge technologies (including AI accelerators, next-gen data centers, and client solutions) and our partners' high-performance cloud/AI platforms. Your mission will be to translate raw hardware and software capabilities into high-value, workload-optimized business solutions that solve real-world customer challenges in the generative AI and accelerated computing space.


Key Responsibilities:


Strategic Co-Marketing Leadership

  • Set the Vision: Develop and execute comprehensive, full-year co-marketing strategies that align Intel's top AI and cloud priorities with our partners' business goals across global, regional, and country levels.

  • Drive the Narrative: Position Intel as the preferred engine behind modern cloud innovation, Neocloud scaling, and AI ISV software stacks through compelling joint value propositions.

High-Impact Partner Engagement

  • Build Strong Alliances: Cultivate and manage deep relationships with Neocloud and AI ISV marketing organizations, engaging confidently with stakeholders from technical leads to senior leadership.

  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the primary liaison between partner teams and Intel's regional partner marketing managers to ensure flawless global alignment.

End-to-End Campaign Mastery

  • Execute with Excellence: Lead the end-to-end project management of co-marketing campaigns-from creative concept and media planning to final execution focused on LLM workloads and AI deployments.

  • Measure What Matters: Own the budget, track KPIs, and deliver rigorous ROI analyses to prove the business impact of every campaign.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Orchestrate Internal Teams: Partner closely with Global Field Sales, Business Units, and country-level teams to ensure joint campaigns are integrated and amplified across all channels.

  • Program Governance and Enablement

  • Manage the Plan of Record (POR): Maintain and update the account's POR, managing co-marketing approvals with precision.

  • Enable Partners: Educate and train partners on program enhancements, guidelines, and toolsets to maximize program participation and compliance.

  • Brand Integrity: Evaluate partner executions to ensure seamless Intel branding integration and adherence to program guidelines.

Executive Communication

  • Tell the Story: Translate complex campaign data into compelling narratives. Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations for Quarterly Marketing Reviews (QMRs) and executive-level briefings.

Thriving in Ambiguity

  • A strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous environments, drive clarity, and deliver highly measurable marketing results in fast-moving technology sectors.

Qualifications:

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

  • Cloud and Ecosystem Marketing Expertise: 6+ years of dedicated cloud marketing, partner marketing, or alliance marketing experience, with a strong preference for backgrounds working directly with or within Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), Neoclouds, or AI/ML-focused SaaS/Enterprise Software partners.

  • Customer-Facing Experience: 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role within a Global Sales or Global Marketing organization, with a proven track record of managing high-value relationships.

  • Project and Vendor Management: Proven experience managing multiple complex workstreams across diverse internal teams and external partners, including marketing agencies, tech platforms, and media vendors.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • AI and Neocloud Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Neocloud ecosystem, LLM deployment architectures, AI frameworks, and the broader AI ISV landscape.

  • Intel and Hardware Knowledge: A strong understanding of Intel's AI solutions, product portfolios, data center technologies, and broader B2B tech landscape.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influencing skills, with a genuine passion for collaborating across a highly matrixed global organization.

  • Polished Communication: Elite customer engagement, relationship management, and presentation skills-comfortable speaking the language of both AI engineers/data scientists and senior executives.

  • Solution Selling Mindset: Experience applying solution selling methodologies to B2B marketing. Proven ability to translate complex technical specifications (like GPU/accelerator performance and LLM inference throughput) into customer-centric business value propositions and joint solution architectures.

  • Vertical Industry Marketing: Experience designing and executing marketing campaigns tailored to specific industry verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, or Public Sector) utilizing AI and cloud infrastructure to solve unique sector-specific challenges.


Why Join Intel?
At Intel, we are game-changers, boundary-pushers, and innovators. In this role, you will have a front-row seat to the future of cloud computing and the autonomy to build marketing campaigns that reach millions of businesses worldwide. We offer a competitive benefits package, a collaborative hybrid work environment, and massive opportunities for career growth.

Life at Intel

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As a Yield Analysis Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and solving yield and reliability challenges to ensure our products meet the highest standards.   • Perform electrical failure analysis (EFA) to address complex yield limiters across product development and high-volume manufacturing phases.

title: PDK Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

We are looking for a skilled DRC Runset Engineer to develop, validate, support, and optimize Design Rule Checking runsets for advanced semiconductor process technology nodes. The candidate will work closely with process development teams, design rule owners, CAD/EDA teams, and design groups to translate design rules into robust, efficient, and production-quality rule decks.
The role requires strong expertise in DRC rule deck development using industry-standard physical verification tools such as Siemens Calibre, Synopsys ICV, and Cadence Pegasus, along with strong debugging, automation, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities:


• Develop, maintain, and support DRC runsets/rule decks for advanced semiconductor process nodes.
• Translate process design rules into accurate and efficient physical verification checks.
• Develop and validate complex geometric, connectivity, density, and process-specific design rule checks using tools such as Calibre, ICV, and Pegasus.
• Create comprehensive test cases to validate rule deck functionality, coverage, and correctness.
• Debug DRC rule deck issues and resolve customer/user-reported problems.
• Improve runset quality, runtime efficiency, scalability, and usability.
• Work closely with process developers, design rule owners and develop runsets.
• Design and implement unit-level and end-to-end validation methodologies for DRC runsets and physical verification flows.
• Provide solutions for complex physical verification and design rule implementation challenges.
• Use AI-based tools and automation techniques to improve rule deck development, validation, and debug productivity.
• Support production users and resolve runset-related issues in a timely manner.
• Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with strong ownership, creativity, and attention to quality.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:


• 4+years of experienced Bachelor's or 2+ years of experienced Master's degree in Electronics, VLSI, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Strong experience in DRC rule deck/runset development for semiconductor technologies.
• Hands-on expertise with one or more physical verification tools Siemens Calibre, Synopsys ICV, Cadence Pegasus
• Good understanding of semiconductor manufacturing process, layout design rules, and physical verification concepts.
• Experience in writing, debugging, and optimizing DRC checks.
• Hands-on experience with layout and debug tools Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre DRV, IC WorkBench
• Strong programming/scripting skills in languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, Shell scripting
• Ability to create and maintain validation test cases and regression suites.
• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

title: CPU Physical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Performs physical design implementation of CPU designs from RTL to GDS to create a design database that is ready for manufacturing. Conducts all aspects of the CPU physical design flow including synthesis, place and route, clock tree synthesis, floor planning, static timing analysis, power/clock distribution, reliability, and power and noise analysis. Conducts verification and signoff including formal equivalence verification, static timing analysis, reliability verification, static and dynamic power integrity, layout verification, electrical rule checking, and structural design checking. Analyzes results and makes recommendations to improve current and future CPU microarchitectures closely collaborating with logic, circuit, architecture, and design automation teams. Possesses CPUspecific expertise in various aspects of structural and physical design, including physical clock design, timing closure, coverage analysis, multiple power domain analysis, structured placement, routing, synthesis, and DFT. Works intimately with industry EDA vendors to build and enhance tool capabilities to design a highspeed, lowpower synthesizable CPU. Optimizes CPU design to improve product level parameters such as power, frequency, and area. Participates in the development and improvement of physical design methodologies and flow automation.

Qualifications:

As a CPU Physical Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in implementing high-performance, low-power CPU designs from RTL to GDSII. You will focus on detailed processes such as synthesis, placement, routing, timing analysis, and power optimization, enabling designs that meet stringent performance and efficiency targets. Your work will directly influence the success of Intel's next-generation CPUs and their manufacturing readiness, contributing to innovative advancements in computing technology. You will join a dynamic team dedicated to designing Intel's latest high-performance CPUs using cutting-edge technologies. This group focuses on delivering innovative solutions that propel Intel's leadership in the semiconductor industry. Collaborating across multiple domains, the team drives groundbreaking designs that support Intel's mission of creating world-changing technologies to enrich the lives of every person on Earth. Key Responsibilities - Perform physical design implementation from RTL to GDSII, including synthesis, placement, routing, clock tree synthesis, and optimization. - Conduct static timing analysis, power distribution analysis, and reliability verification to ensure design convergence and high manufacturability. - Collaborate with logic, circuit, architecture, and automation teams to improve CPU microarchitectures and design methodologies. - Work closely with industry-leading EDA vendors to enhance tool capabilities for high-speed, low-power CPU development. - Optimize designs for power, frequency, and area, ensuring product-level parameter excellence. - Participate in developing and improving physical design methodologies and flow automation for future projects. Qualifications - B. Tech or M. Tech degree in Electrical, Electronics with 10+ years of relevant experience. - Technical expertise in synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing tools, particularly using Synopsys and Cadence platforms. - Proficiency in timing signoff, formal verification, and low-power design techniques. - Solid understanding of submicron process node technologies and layout verification methods such as LVS/DRC. - Skilled in power estimation, power optimization, and power delivery methodologies. Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Python for automating physical design workflows. - Experience with Verilog or VHDL for hardware description and design execution. - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, for collaborative problem-solving. - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in dynamic environments across geographies. - Knowledge of innovative feature feasibility studies and SD flow methodologies. Be part of a world-class team driving innovation in CPU design. Apply today to contribute to Intel's mission of shaping the future of technology.

title: Silicon Photonics Component Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As a Silicon Photonics (SiPho) Component Design Engineer, you will join Intel Foundry's Silicon Photonics Process Development and Manufacturing (SPDM) team, which is driving process innovation and enabling the next generation of optical interconnect technologies. Since pioneering the world's first heterogeneous silicon laser nearly a decade ago, Intel has continued to lead the industry through advanced technology development and scalable high-volume manufacturing.

Our team is committed to expanding Intel Foundry's Silicon Photonics platform to support customer solutions across data center communications, co-packaged optics, and next-generation optical networking technologies ranging from 400G to 3.2T+ and beyond.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of silicon photonic components that power cutting-edge optical communication systems. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to design, characterize, and improve photonic devices while advancing Intel Foundry's silicon photonics technology roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Photonic Component Design and Development

  • Design, simulate, and support the development of photonic components, including lasers, modulators, high-speed photodetectors, passive devices, and waveguide structures.
  • Contribute to photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design and architecture evaluations.

Device Optimization and Analysis

  • Perform simulations, tolerance studies, and design evaluations to improve device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
  • Apply established modeling methodologies and design best practices to optimize photonic components.

Test Chip Development and Validation

  • Support test chip execution activities, including design implementation, layout coordination, tape-out preparation, and silicon validation.
  • Collaborate with fabrication and test teams to ensure successful design realization.

Characterization and Data Analysis

  • Analyze characterization and test data to identify performance trends, root causes, and opportunities for design enhancement.
  • Support the implementation of design improvements based on experimental results.

Modeling and Methodology Development

  • Contribute to photonic device models, simulation workflows, and automation tools.
  • Drive improvements in test methodologies and engineering processes to increase development efficiency.

Research and Technology Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging photonic technologies and support proof-of-concept demonstrations.
  • Contribute to intellectual property development through patents, technical publications, and innovation activities.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline with 2+ years of experience in silicon photonic device design, simulation, characterization, or related research environments;

or

  • Master's degree in a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • High-speed photonic devices, including optical modulators and photodetectors;
    • Photonic design and simulation using tools such as Sentaurus, Silvaco, Lumerical, HFSS, ADS, RSoft, or equivalent;
    • Photonic device testing and characterization; data analysis using MATLAB, Python, JMP, or similar tools;
    • Photonic layout design using Cadence, KLayout, or comparable design environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional engineering environment.
  • Experience with silicon photonic modulator or detector design.
  • Familiarity with micro-ring modulators or advanced photonic materials such as BTO, TFLN, or III-V integration.
  • Basic understanding of high-speed electronic ICs including TIAs, drivers, equalization techniques, and DSP concepts.
  • Experience with optical link modeling and system-level performance analysis.
  • Experience with photonic devices operating at 100G+ data rates.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor foundry development processes.
  • Publications, conference presentations, or patent contributions in photonics or related fields.
  • Experience working on customer-facing, product development, or cross-functional engineering projects.
  • Experience with active and passive silicon photonic devices including heaters, carrier injection devices, and passive waveguide structures.

title: Back-End TD Reliability Lab Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

 As one of the world's largest semiconductor manufacturers, Intel is committed to advancing every aspect of semiconductor technology, from process development and manufacturing to advanced packaging and reliability characterization.
Employees within Intel Foundry are part of a global network spanning technology development, manufacturing, assembly, test, and quality organizations across both front-end silicon and advanced packaging facilities.
You will join the Foundry Lab Network (FLN), a key organization within Foundry Quality, Reliability, and Labs (FQRL), located at Intel's growing Chandler, Arizona site. This site serves as the technology development hub for Intel's most advanced packaging technologies, including Hybrid Bond Interconnect (HBI), Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge (EMIB-T), glass substrates, Foveros, and future advanced packaging innovations.
FLN is actively expanding its laboratory capabilities and capacity to support Intel Foundry's roadmap, enabling faster technology qualification and accelerating development cycles through Quick Turn Monitoring (QTM) solutions that significantly reduce time-to-data.
As the Stress Test and Reliability (STaR) Back-End Laboratory Manager, you will play a critical leadership role within FLN. You will partner closely with Packaging Technology Development, Quality and Reliability, and Failure Analysis teams to establish and enhance laboratory capabilities that support qualification and certification of next-generation packaging technologies and products.
This position offers a unique combination of people leadership, technical problem solving, and organizational strategy. You will lead a team of 7-10 talented engineers, spearhead cross-functional efforts to resolve complex reliability and technology challenges, drive strong quality and operational excellence across the laboratory, and develop a high-performing organization focused on innovation and customer responsiveness.
Our Chandler site offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor innovation while enjoying life in the greater Phoenix metropolitan area and the scenic Sonoran Desert, with easy access to world-renowned destinations such as Sedona and the Grand Canyon.
 

Your key deliverables will include:
• Managing, hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team of 8-10 laboratory engineers while building an organization recognized as a destination team within the site.
• Defining and executing the laboratory capability and capacity roadmap to anticipate and meet future customer and technology requirements.
• Ensuring timely and effective response to both internal and external customer needs.
• Developing and implementing a comprehensive strategy to support data collection and qualification requirements for emerging packaging technologies.
• Establishing and advancing Reliability Quick Turn Monitoring (QTM) methodologies to accelerate technology development cycles and decision making.
• Driving a culture of operational excellence, quality leadership, and continuous improvement across the laboratory.
• Leading the laboratory's quality management system development and readiness efforts to achieve ISO 17025 accreditation, including driving effective 8D/root cause analysis for the engineering team.

Behavioral traits:
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Strong relationship-building, networking, and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Proven ability to influence and drive initiatives across organizational boundaries.
• High emotional intelligence and the ability to lead effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.
• Ability to perform successfully in dynamic, fast-paced, and evolving environments.
• Demonstrated capability to manage multiple priorities and parallel initiatives in resource-constrained situations

Qualifications:

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
This position is intended for candidates with demonstrated engineering leadership experience and a successful track record of leading teams to solve complex technical challenges.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.
• 3+ years of engineering management experience in semiconductor packaging, reliability engineering (product or process), test engineering, or validation engineering.

title: Lead Humanoid Robotics System Architect
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact
This role serves as the authoritative systems architect owning the end-to-end hierarchical stack for next-generation humanoid robots. Acting as the critical interface between large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models and physical platforms, this senior leader defines hierarchical multi-system architecture requirements and drives the co-optimization of advanced AI models with physical hardware under tight power, thermal, latency, and memory-bandwidth constraints.

Key Responsibilities

  • Humanoid Robotic System Architecture Ownership: Own the canonical hierarchical control stack, including VLM/VLA systems, visuomotor policies, whole-body control, and distributed joint FOC loops. You will also establish rate boundaries, latency budgets, action-chunking strategies, and select interconnect topologies (e.g., EtherCAT).
  • AI Model Optimization for Silicon: Drive co-optimization of large VLA/world models with compute silicon. Define quantization, sparsity/MoE, context lengths, and reference deployment envelopes to align model workloads with silicon capabilities.
  • Co-Optimized Model + Hardware Architecture: Perform first-principles sizing of FLOPs, sustained TOPS, and memory-bandwidth floors. Select optimal compute platforms and design strategic splits of AI workloads between central compute nodes and remote sensor pods.
  • Key Deliverables with Cross-Functional Impact
  • Technical Leadership and Specifications: Author and maintain primary system-level specifications (compute, power, thermal, sensors, actuator networks, safety islands) and translate high-level product goals into actionable, quantitative requirements. Guide evolution of relevant technology roadmaps from current baselines to future system concepts that would influence product definition.
  • Cross-Functional Authority: Lead multi-disciplinary architecture reviews, key decisions, and subsystem design trades across ML research, controls, electrical, firmware, and mechanical teams.
  • Collaborative Experimentation and Mentorship: Formulate and guide expert-led viability experiments. Mentor senior engineers in system-level thinking, addressing critical hardware barriers like the memory and power walls, and represent the platform architecture with key external silicon and actuator partners.
  • Architectural Expertise: Proven ownership of architectures bridging high-level AI models with real-time hardware control, alongside deep fluency in transformer inference constraints (quantization, action chunking, memory bandwidth walls) and real-time distributed systems (EtherCAT, zonal sensor pods, safety islands).
  • Exceptional technical communication with a track record of writing rigorous, quantitative system specs and driving alignment across diverse engineering domains.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Core Experience: 10+ years in complex cyber-physical systems, with 4-5 years specializing in robotics, autonomous systems, or high-performance edge AI platforms.
  • BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or related field is required.

Preferred Assets: Direct experience with humanoid robots/mobile manipulators, hands-on exposure to VLA/foundation models (-series, Helix-class, GR00T, OpenVLA, or equivalent), expertise with robotics platforms (NVIDIA Jetson / IGX platforms, custom AI silicon, or both), and battery/thermal budgeting for highly constrained systems.
