title: Compiler Engineering Graduate Intern
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join Us in Shaping the Future


At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.


The Team
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.


Position Overview
We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on an engineering or research project that may involve compiler features, MLIR-based intermediate representations, Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), optimization, code generation, runtime or offload support, debug information, testing infrastructure, performance analysis, or developer tools. Projects may connect hardware capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for a graduate student who can apply deeper technical expertise to an ambiguous engineering or research problem, evaluate alternatives, and deliver a well-supported solution or prototype.


Responsibilities
• Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, or analysis of compiler and runtime technologies.
• Develop and debug software in C or C++ within a large, collaborative codebase.
• Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions.
• Evaluate functional correctness, compile-time behavior, runtime performance, or code quality, as applicable to the project.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and team members.
• Document designs, experiments, results, and lessons learned, and present project outcomes to the team.
• Contribute to open-source projects when aligned with the assigned work.


Success in This Role

• Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

• Clear written and verbal communication.

• Ability to work independently on scoped tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

• Collaborative mindset and commitment to high-quality engineering.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.

• Graduate-level coursework, research, or project experience in compilers, programming languages, computer architecture, parallel computing, systems software, or a closely related area.

• Experience programming in C or C++ and working with complex software systems.

• Experience designing experiments, analyzing technical results, and communicating conclusions.


Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with LLVM, MLIR, Clang, Flang, SYCL/DPC++, Triton, OpenMP, CUDA, or another compiler or parallel-programming ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with LLVM or related compiler infrastructure, including front-end development, intermediate representations, optimization passes, code generation, runtimes, or debug information.

• Research or development experience involving CPU/GPU architectures, heterogeneous computing, AI/ML compilation, HPC, parallel programming, or performance optimization.

• Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning models such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Kimi.

• Tile-base programming model knowledge

• GPU Compute kernel writing experience

• Experience contributing to open-source software or working in a large collaborative codebase.

• Publications, technical reports, patents, open-source contributions, or other evidence of advanced technical work.

The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models.

You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.

Position Overview

We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on a scoped project that may involve:

  • Compiler features or MLIR-based intermediate representations
  • Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs)
  • Optimization, code generation, runtime, or offload support
  • Debug information or testing infrastructure
  • Performance analysis or developer tools

Projects may involve connecting software capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning models such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Kimi.

You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for an undergraduate student who wants to build practical compiler-engineering experience and apply foundational computer science concepts to production software.

To Be Successful in This Role

As a Signal Integrity Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, simulating, and optimizing electrical interconnects, ensuring exceptional performance and reliability in next-generation technologies. Business group The Data Center Group (DCG) focuses on delivering innovative technologies that power the world's most advanced data centers. title: AI Frameworks Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact


Intel is building the open software stack that makes large language models run fast on Intel GPUs. You will join the engineering team that develops and optimizes LLM inference frameworks - working directly in vLLM and in the SW stack beneath it and in the upstream. You will write and tune compute kernels, reshape execution paths, hunt performance bottlenecks and submit your changes into widely used open-source projects. If you want to optimize how fast AI workloads run, this is that role.

Business group


The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge technologies to power the world's data centers, enabling advanced computing solutions that drive innovation across industries. Within this group, our team is dedicated to developing AI frameworks and workloads that empower researchers and developers to create high-performance, scalable solutions for complex AI challenges. We aim to build tools and technologies that accelerate progress in AI, aligning with Intel's mission to advance global technology.

Key Responsibilities


- Design, develop, and optimize AI framework software for LLM inference on Intel GPUs, contributing upstream to external open-source frameworks such as vLLM and PyTorch.
- Develop and optimize compute kernels for transformer inference.
- Implement and tune distributed execution paths - tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism, collective communication, and asynchronous data movement within deep learning frameworks.
- Transform and optimize the computational-graph representation of neural network models, and develop machine learning primitives in mathematical and kernel libraries.
- Profile inference workloads to identify performance bottlenecks across the stack, quantify them, and propose and drive solutions together with the individual component teams that own each layer.
- Optimize code for a range of computing hardware backends, adapting implementations to the memory hierarchy, instruction set, and execution model of each target.
- Build and extend unit tests, correctness checks, and performance regression coverage so that framework and kernel work stays reliable as upstream moves.
- Collaborate with framework, compiler, and machine learning engineers across global teams, and engage with the open-source community through code review and technical discussion.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications


- Bachelor's degree in AI, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.
- 4+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 3+ years with a Master's degree.
- Advanced expertise in Python programming.
- Hands-on experience with AI inference and large language models (LLMs).
- Demonstrated proficiency in PyTorch.
- Solid foundation in AI frameworks, machine learning algorithms, and software engineering practices.
- Strong problem-solving skills with experience in debugging and designing optimized software and algorithms.
- Proficiency in Linux environments from a user perspective.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in performance profiling and optimization for AI workloads, including reading and interpreting hardware-level profiles.
- Familiarity with parallel and distributed computing concepts and collective communication libraries.
- Familiarity with vLLM or another LLM inference serving framework.
- Track record of accepted contributions to a major open-source AI project.
- Understanding of numerical precision and quantization formats (FP8, INT8, INT4) and their accuracy implications.
- Knowledge of writing/optimizing GPU compute kernels is a plus.
- Creativity and innovative thinking in solving technical and system-level challenges.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work across global teams.

title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact:


Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.


About the Team:


The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.

The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.



Key Responsibilities:


·   Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack.

·   Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture.

·   Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes.

·   Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization.

·   Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies.

·   Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling.

·   Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware.

·   Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance.

·   Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements.

Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:


·   BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

·   Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms.

·   Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements.

·   Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust.

·   Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior.

·   Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools.


Preferred Qualifications:


·   Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8.

·   Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent.

·   Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms.

·   Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling.

·   Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions.

·   Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects.


Why Join This Team?


This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span:


Agentic AI & LLMs → AI frameworks → inference runtimes Linux → server architecture → silicon


You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers.

The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms.

title: AI Frameworks Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact


Intel is building the open software stack that makes large language models run fast on Intel GPUs. You will join the engineering team that develops and optimizes LLM inference frameworks - working directly in vLLM and in the GPU kernel libraries beneath it, upstream and in the open.


This is a deeply technical, inward-facing engineering role: your work is the framework itself. You will write and tune compute kernels, reshape execution paths, hunt performance bottlenecks down to the hardware, and land your changes in widely used open-source projects. If you want your code to decide how fast an entire class of AI workloads runs, this is that role.

Business group


The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge technologies to power the world's data centers, enabling advanced computing solutions that drive innovation across industries. Within this group, our team is dedicated to developing AI frameworks and workloads that empower researchers and developers to create high-performance, scalable solutions for complex AI challenges. We aim to build tools and technologies that accelerate progress in AI, aligning with Intel's mission to advance global technology.

Key Responsibilities


- Design, develop, and optimize AI framework software for LLM inference on Intel GPUs, contributing upstream to external open-source frameworks such as vLLM and PyTorch.
- Develop and optimize compute kernels (e.g., Triton, SYCL) for attention, mixture-of-experts, quantization, normalization, and other core building blocks of transformer inference.
- Implement and tune distributed execution paths - tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism, collective communication, and asynchronous data movement within deep learning frameworks.
- Transform and optimize the computational-graph representation of neural network models, and develop machine learning primitives in mathematical and kernel libraries.
- Profile inference workloads to identify performance bottlenecks across the stack, quantify them, and propose and drive solutions together with the individual component teams that own each layer.
- Optimize code for a range of computing hardware backends, adapting implementations to the memory hierarchy, instruction set, and execution model of each target.
- Build and extend unit tests, correctness checks, and performance regression coverage so that framework and kernel work stays reliable as upstream moves.
- Collaborate with framework, compiler, and machine learning engineers across global teams, and engage with the open-source community through code review and technical discussion.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications


- Bachelor's degree in AI, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.
- At least 2-3 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 1+ year with a Master's degree.
- Advanced expertise in Python programming.
- Demonstrated proficiency in PyTorch, including its internals or extension mechanisms.
- Hands-on experience with AI inference and large language models (LLMs).
- Strong problem-solving skills with experience in debugging and designing optimized software and algorithms.
- Proficiency in Linux environments from a user perspective.
- Solid foundation in AI frameworks, machine learning algorithms, and software engineering practices.

Preferred Qualification


- Experience writing or optimizing GPU compute kernels (Triton, CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, or similar).
- Experience in performance profiling and optimization for AI workloads, including reading and interpreting hardware-level profiles.
- Familiarity with parallel and distributed computing concepts and collective communication libraries.
- Familiarity with vLLM or another LLM inference serving framework.
- Track record of accepted contributions to a major open-source AI project.
- Understanding of numerical precision and quantization formats (FP8, INT8, INT4) and their accuracy implications.
- Creativity and innovative thinking in solving technical and system-level challenges.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work across global teams.

Bring your passion for AI, innovative thinking, and technical expertise to Intel, where you will contribute to groundbreaking advancements that impact the world for years to come.

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join a leading technology company at the forefront of innovation in graphics processing and semiconductor technology. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in the world of computing, delivering cutting-edge solutions that power the future of digital experiences. Our team is composed of talented professionals who are passionate about technology and dedicated to excellence. We are seeking a skilled and experienced GPU Validation Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role requires regular onsite presence to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and fulfill essential job responsibilities.


As a GPU Validation Engineer, you will define, develop, and perform functional validation for Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), focusing on the interaction of GPUs with media, display, and system-level features.

You will apply various hardware and software tools and techniques to ensure comprehensive validation coverage and achieve performance, power, and area goals.

  • Publishes GPU validation reports summarizing all validation activities performed, reviews results, and communicates to relevant teams.

Join Intel's cutting-edge team as a Formal Verification Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our next-generation IP and SoC designs. title: Power Delivery Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Are you passionate about computing and AI accelerators?

Do you thrive on innovation and want to disrupt the industry? Are you eager to work with leading AI hardware engineers on Intel's latest architecture? If you love collaborating with diverse teams to create best-in-class AI compute platforms, Intel's GPE department has exciting opportunities for you.

As a member of the GPE team, you will develop hardware and platform solutions for Intel products, including the newest IPs targeted at next-generation GPUs and AI accelerators.


You will have the opportunity to engage in enabling technologies in PCB design, manufacturing, testing, and debugging. We are a winning team with a clear vision of delivering competitive and cutting-edge products, and we are committed to building the best products and developing the best skills for our team.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Work on end-to-end power delivery design and development, from initial concept to implementation of power delivery requirements and ecosystem enabling power integrated circuits.
  • Own power integrity simulation for the platform power delivery network: build and correlate VRM-to-die PDN models, run DC IR-drop and AC target-impedance analysis, and perform transient droop and Ldi/dt studies across die, package, and PCB to set the decoupling and stack up strategy before layout is committed.
  • Apply knowledge of power conversion topologies, including components, compensation circuits/stability analysis, drop/droop analysis, simulation tools, and techniques, as well as PCB layout and design tools, to characterize performance and validate correlation of simulation modeling and results.
  • Design and validate platform power conversion and management solutions, including energy management, and perform simulation and optimization for package and PCB, including stack up, power/ground noise plane assignment, decoupling solutions, and/or power sequencing requirements.
  • Design for debug: architect observability into the board from the start, including per-rail voltage and current sense points, Kelvin-sense and probe landing points, telemetry and current-monitor access (SVID/PMBus/IMON), rail-level isolation and enable control, and voltage-margining , so power-on and post-silicon issues can be isolated on the first board instead of a respin.
  • Design for flexibility: build configurability into the power delivery solution so a single board can support multiple SKUs and derivatives, using stuffing options for phase count and decoupling, pin-compatible dual-source regulator footprints, rail split/merge and current headroom for higher-power SKUs, and programmable load line, compensation, and VID range.
  • Create and execute test plans to validate and characterize power delivery solutions.
  • Correlate bench and VR test tool measurements with simulation results to improve simulation model accuracy and close the loop on power integrity assumptions.
  • Conduct failure analysis and root cause investigations for power delivery issues, implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Collaborate with silicon and platform architects to generate solutions and analyses, delivering content into platform design guides as solution collaterals for end customers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including board design, SW/FW, and systems validation, to ensure seamless integration of power delivery solutions.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications, you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in:
    • Designing low voltage, high current, multi-phase DC-DC switching regulators (buck, boost, etc.) to meet stringent targets, optimizing the design for transient response and conversion efficiency.
    • Working with signal/power integrity and power delivery network simulation tools such as Cadence Sigrity PowerDC/PowerSI, Ansys SIwave etc. to develop accurate models of circuit design 
    • Design and optimize accurate power delivery simulation models using SPICE and time-based simulation tools (LTSpice, SIMPLIS etc.) based on SOC design power requirements.
    • Power delivery network modeling across die, package, and PCB, including stackup, plane assignment, decoupling network design, and S-parameter extraction and correlation.
    • Experience using oscilloscopes and DAQ for hardware troubleshooting and debugging.
    • Interacting with Signal Integrity, Layout, and Mechanical engineers, with working knowledge of SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical aspects of board designs.

Preferred Qualifications, are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • Experience designing for debug and testability on power delivery hardware, including sense and telemetry instrumentation, voltage margining, and rail isolation for post-silicon bring-up.
  • Experience designing configurable power delivery solutions that support multiple SKUs and derivative products from a single board design.
  • Identify new technologies/interfaces and develop board power delivery architecture.
  • Experience in project management, including leading projects and manage timelines and resources effectively.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies such as GaN power devices, switched capacitor topology, etc.
  • Experience delivering products for high-volume production and cost optimization.
  • Knowledge of board and power management (HW/SW/FW) debugging.
  • Willing to provide hardware technical support to ODM/OEM board vendors.
  • Willingness to travel globally to meet internal teams and external customers.

Join us and build on our legacy of innovation and collaboration as we deliver world‑changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet.

As a Sort/Test Quality & Reliability Engineer, you will lead quality and reliability readiness for tester hardware, test modules, test processes, manufacturing systems, and supplier-developed solutions used in semiconductor development and high-volume manufacturing. Drive shift-left risk prevention, qualification rigor, test process certification, and disciplined HVM transfer through cross-functional execution with Test Development, Product Engineering, Manufacturing QnR, ATM, factories, suppliers, and ODM partners.


Your responsibilities may include but not limited to:

  • Test Process Definition and Certification: Lead pathfinding, test process development, qualification, certification, and HVM ramp across products, architectures, Sort, and back-end test.
  • QnR Requirements and Risk Prevention: Define requirements, readiness criteria, acceptance plans, FMEA, and mitigation closure for tester platforms, modules, interface hardware, burn-in, wafer/die sort, metrology, and supplier hardware.
  • Qualification Strategy: Lead Installation Qualification, Module Operational Qualification, Measurement System Analysis, HVM and Transfer Qualification, Reliability Validation, Change Qualification, and production release reviews.
  • Module Manufacturing Qualification: Ensure test processes achieve quality, yield, miscorrelation, gain, capability, stability, cost, and customer-risk objectives before transfer and during ramp.
  • Technology Transfer and Factory Support: Enable successful and timely transfer to ATM factories; provide effective IPG QRE support for engineering, qualification, pilot, and revenue production.
  • Methodology Ownership: Own, define, and update Test Process Certification methods, specifications, critical success indicators, qualification templates, and release criteria.
  • QMS Deployment: Establish and maintain FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, OCAP, calibration, traceability, data integrity, change control, work instructions, and audit-ready evidence.
  • Excursion and Corrective Action Leadership: Lead MQE, excursion, yield, hardware, and reliability investigations using 8D, 5 Why, fault isolation, DOE, and model-based problem solving; verify corrective action effectiveness and recurrence prevention.
  • Analytics and Continuous Improvement: Use statistical analysis and manufacturing data to monitor process health, predict emerging risk, reduce escapes, improve qualification efficiency, and strengthen certification decisions.

title: Intel Foundry Senior Customer Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact

As a Customer Quality and Reliability Engineer within Intel Foundry, you will take a hands-on leadership role in ensuring that Intel Foundry meets and exceeds industry benchmarks for semiconductor manufacturing quality, reliability, and customer responsiveness.

In this role, you will act as a primary advocate for external customers across Intel Foundry partner organizations and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) services. By spearheading incident and excursion management, facilitating customer audits, driving structured problem-solving, and developing next-generation quality systems, you will directly influence operational excellence and strengthen collaborative relationships with our global customers.

Business Group

Intel Foundry is dedicated to delivering industry-leading, world-class semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging solutions to global customers. The Customer Quality Engineering (CQE) team plays a mission-critical role in this vision by safeguarding manufacturing quality and product reliability, driving cross-site continuous improvement, and aligning internal processes with rigorous industry standards. Our team partners closely with customers and internal engineering groups to ensure Intel Foundry is recognized as a trusted, world-class manufacturing partner.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary customer advocate and technical interface for customer quality inquiries, representing customer interests across Intel Foundry and external OSAT partner organizations to deliver timely, collaborative solutions.
  • Direct end-to-end incident and excursion management processes for customer materials, driving structured root-cause investigations, material disposition, and preventative corrective actions.
  • Lead and support structured problem-solving initiatives utilizing rigorous methodologies such as 8D, RMA, and Change Notification Management (PCNs).
  • Facilitate and support customer quality audits, ensuring comprehensive compliance with international industry standards including ISO9001 and IATF16949.
  • Drive continuous improvement by designing, deploying, and standardizing next-generation quality management systems, collateral, and structured business processes across foundry and OSAT operations.
  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to track, analyze, and report key performance indicators (KPIs), conducting regular quality reviews to continuously enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Champion cross-functional collaboration internally to advocate for customer quality requirements and drive service, process, and yield improvements throughout manufacturing, assembly, and test operations.

Qualifications:

Candidates must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. The experience listed below may be obtained through schoolwork, classes and project work, internships, military training, and/or work experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field with 4+ years of hands-on experience in quality, reliability, or semiconductor manufacturing processes; OR
  • Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field with 3+ years of hands-on experience in quality, reliability, or semiconductor manufacturing processes; OR
  • PhD in Engineering or a related technical field with 1+ years of hands-on experience in quality, reliability, or semiconductor manufacturing processes.
  • 1+ years of experience in the following:
    • Quality and reliability systems, excursion management, and structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis).
    • Proficiency working with quality management standards and audit frameworks (such as ISO9001 and IATF16949).
    • Technical familiarity with silicon process technology, advanced packaging, or foundry manufacturing environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones, including regular engagement during Asia workday hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comprehensive technical knowledge of silicon technology, IC package technology, assembly process technology, advanced packaging architecture, and semiconductor industry standards.
  • Direct experience managing quality and reliability interfaces with external customers, foundries, and OSAT partners.
  • In-depth familiarity with industry manufacturing quality processes, including incoming/outgoing quality assurance (IQA/OQA), Product Change Notifications (PCNs), Manufacturing Baseline Process Specifications (MBPS), and FACR workflows.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving and negotiation capabilities, with a proven ability to balance customer requirements with internal business and operational priorities.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional leadership skills in a dynamic, rapidly evolving business environment.

We are seeking collaborative, driven professionals who want to make a tangible impact by championing quality improvement, fostering customer trust, and advancing Intel Foundry's goal of delivering world-class semiconductor solutions. Join us to be part of a team committed to innovation, engineering excellence, and customer success.

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join our Intel Foundry Construction & Sourcing (FCS) in building the world's largest semiconductor manufacturing factories across the globe. Our enterprise manages a portfolio of capital projects on-site with a large contractor workforce that encompasses outsourced general contractors, A/E firms, and key trade companies in the Semiconductor Construction Industry. The scope of our work includes but is not limited to New Wafer Fabrication factories (Fabs), Fab Conversions, Process Tools Install, Infrastructure, and Progressive Build.  Intel Foundry works to advance manufacturing capabilities and deliver cutting-edge semiconductor solutions to customers worldwide.
 
We are looking for world-class technical talent to join our team. If you enjoy working with the latest technology in a rewarding, fast-paced environment, this is the right place for you. Everywhere you go, you'll find an opportunity to make a difference. In any given workday, you will be given the responsibility to innovate and create an impact on our business. 
This is an onsite position at our campus in New Albany, OH.  

 
This Project Controls Engineer (PCE) position is part of the Project Controls Group (PCG) organization supporting the Ohio Foundry Construction Sourcing (FCS) projects. The PCE is an integral member of a project team. It also includes members from the Construction, Procurement, Engineering and Intel Customer organizations. 
 
The PCE is responsible for all cost/estimating/schedule controls and for the project to help ensure the project is delivered on time and at the best cost to Intel. This role is one of the few opportunities where Cost Engineers and/or Cost Estimators can both develop and perfect project management skills working with the project team, finance and customer operations personnel as well as external suppliers.  

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:  

  • Cost reporting including commits approval and tracking at the detailed WBS level. 
  • Lead monthly project forecast development, funding requests and reporting. 
  • Enforcing project controls incorporating the schedule, productivity, Earned Value. 
  • Partner in the estimate development 
  • Driving process improvements. 
  • Presenting financial updates to project/senior management with confidence. 
  • Influencing cost reduction cash savings opportunities using financial analysis skills. 
  • Leading and consolidating project Close and POR (Financial Plan of Record) submissions. 
  • Drives cost reduction strategies and interfaces with local levels of management, customer finance and capital finance. 
  • Ensures compliance with reporting standards, local and corporate policies and the integrity of external and internal reporting.

  • Supports business by closing the books, analyzing variances and trends, and developing project forecasts that are consistent with the business objectives of the organization. 
  • Provides information and counsel in the areas of controls/risk management, claims mitigation, budgeting and planning, pricing, cost, marketing strategies, return on investment decisions, and the development of overall business plans and strategies. 
  • Interprets information for and negotiates with clients and customers both internal and external to the organization. 
  • Provides input to management including department heads, operational managers, other departments, and senior management. 
  • Manage change control processes to ensure deviations from project scope are properly assessed and documented.

In addition to the qualifications a successful candidate will demonstrate: 

  • Develop and model complex financials and make recommendations. 
  • Work in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.

  • Strong Communication skills, to communicate trends and insights to project and senior management.

title: Technology Development Foundry Engineering – Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As the world's largest chip manufacturer and a global leader in innovation and advanced technology, Intel strives to make every aspect of semiconductor manufacturing state of the art, from process development and manufacturing to yield improvement, packaging, final test, optimization, and world-class supply chain and facilities support. Employees in the Technology Development and Manufacturing Group are part of a worldwide network of design, development, manufacturing, and assembly/test facilities focused on utilizing the power of Moore's Law to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth. We are constantly working to create a more connected and intelligent future, and we need your help. Change tomorrow. Start today.


What We Offer: We foster a collaborative, supportive, and exciting environment where some of the brightest minds in the world come together to achieve exceptional results. We provide opportunities to transform technology and create a better future by delivering products that impact the lives of people around the globe.


Life at Intel: https://jobs.intel.com/en/life-at-intel


What We Do: Join the Logic Technology Development (LTD) organization, a powerhouse of process technology innovation driving Intel's IDM 2.0 strategy and enabling the success of our global foundry customers.


We are seeking a versatile Staff Engineer to be at the forefront of Intel's foundry transformation, serving as a pivotal technical partner who guides customers through the entire product development lifecycle. In this role, you will leverage multidisciplinary expertise spanning product/process integration, device engineering, and yield engineering to lead customers from pre-silicon evaluation and design tape-out through testing, validation, silicon qualification, and production ramp.This is a unique opportunity to apply broad technical leadership, solve complex challenges, face customers, and actively shape the future of the semiconductor industry in the AI era.


What You Will Do: We are seeking candidates with broad semiconductor expertise across foundry technology development. Depending on experience and business needs, responsibilities may include the following areas:


Product/Process Integration

  • Drive end-to-end Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) and New Product Introduction (NPI) execution across the full manufacturing flow, from front-end processing through far backend operations, ensuring quality and on-time delivery.
  • Serve as the primary customer-facing interface for silicon execution including wafer status, silicon health, technical issues, process changes, and execution alignment.
  • Own identification and resolution of customer-specific integration challenges.
  • Drive enablement of customer-specific requirements through effective cross-functional coordination.

Device Engineering

  • Serve as the primary customer interface for device performance, including manufacturing readiness reviews, performance roadmaps and projections, post-silicon characterization, model to hardware correlation, and resolution of customer-specific device issues.
  • Track device performance targets and process control capability while assessing alignment between silicon results and PDK expectations.
  • Drive device performance optimization through silicon learning, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional corrective actions to improve product readiness and close performance gaps.

Yield Engineering

  • Serve as the primary yield point of contact throughout the product lifecycle, from design tape-out through High Volume Manufacturing (HVM).
  • Develop predictive yield models to identify parametric and defect-related loss mechanisms and provide yield projections for test chips, shuttle vehicles, and production products.
  • Lead deep-dive investigations into yield signals and nonconformances, partnering with Process Integration, Device Engineering, and Defect Metrology teams to eliminate systematic yield losses. Perform root-cause analysis leveraging on state-of-the-art FI/FA.
  • Establish strong correlations between inline process metrics and end-of-line yield performance to improve process control and production predictability.

Benefits: Intel provides benefits that promote a healthy and enjoyable lifestyle, including comprehensive medical coverage, wellness programs, recreational activities, paid time off, employee discounts, and many additional benefits that help make Intel a Great Place to Work.Intel's future-of-work strategy is grounded in the belief that people are our most important asset. We are committed to a hybrid-first approach that provides flexibility while enabling strong collaboration and business success.

title: Yield Product Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

About the Role

As a Yield Product Development Engineer, you will be at the forefront of advancing Intel's cutting-edge process technologies within our Manufacturing Development and Customer Engineering (MDCE) organization. This pivotal role involves identifying root cause yield limiters and driving solutions that enhance manufacturability and yield across technology nodes. You will work within a dynamic, fast-paced environment to ensure the successful introduction of new products, process improvements, and robust methodologies to meet manufacturing goals. Your expertise will directly contribute to Intel's ability to deliver world-class semiconductor solutions and advance the future of computing.

Your responsibilities as a Yield Product Development Engineer will include but not be limited to:

  • Develop methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze diverse big data sources for defect mode understanding and yield modeling.
  • Perform statistical analysis, create visualizations, and construct process development roadmaps that drive technology yield milestones.
  • Extract insights from structured and unstructured data using advanced statistics, machine learning, and coding techniques.
  • Organize, interpret, and structure insights from fab process, defect, and electrical data while identifying anomalies to drive process changes for yield enhancement.
  • Develop multivariate algorithms and tools to identify root cause yield limiters and recommend process changes for yield improvement.
  • Collaborate with design teams to resolve yield issues, ensuring manufacturability across process and product specifications before ramping production.
  • Execute new product introductions, enable design-technology co-optimization, and participate in design of experiments with factory task forces.
  • Develop measurement recipes for rapid feedback on product integrity and address issues impacting yield or product quality.
  • Create and harden systems capable of meeting operational needs for leading-edge logic nodes, working with equipment vendors and internal collaborators.
  • Develop AI/ML applications and computational tools to bridge the gap between design and manufacturing, improve design efficiency, and reduce debug time.
  • Document technical procedures, train colleagues, and debug equipment, software, and procedural failures in production environments when required.

Qualifications:

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.  Minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • Master's Degree or Ph.D. in semiconductor science-related STEM degree in engineering, physical science, computer science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience with Master's, -or- 2+ years of experience with Ph.D. in advanced semiconductor devices and process flow.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Senior GPU Physical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.

The Role and Impact:

As a GPU Physical Design Engineer, you will play a critical role in the physical implementation of cutting-edge GPU designs from RTL to GDS, ensuring optimal performance, power, and area. You will be responsible for executing key aspects of the physical design flow, including synthesis, place and route, timing analysis, and verification, driving the success of Intel's next-generation graphics products.

Business group:

You will join Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a team dedicated to creating innovative technologies for data center and enterprise solutions. DCG focuses on delivering high-performance computing systems, enabling Intel's mission to advance data-driven insights and empower businesses worldwide.

The primary responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to:

  • Perform physical design implementation of GPU designs, including synthesis, placement, routing, and clock tree synthesis.
  • Conduct verification and signoff tasks, such as static timing analysis, layout verification, and formal equivalence checking.
  • Analyze results and collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize design for power, frequency, and area.
  • Develop and improve physical design methodologies and flow automation for continuous innovation in GPU physical design.

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation that shapes the future of technology. With a legacy of over 50 years of engineering excellence, Intel is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge solutions in computing, connectivity, and advanced manufacturing. Our Advanced Packaging Technology Development – Substrate and Wafer Assembly (ATPD: SWA) organization is a global leader in delivering innovative, cost-effective substrate packaging solutions that power the devices and infrastructure of tomorrow. At Intel Arizona, we are proud to be part of a thriving technology hub where world-class talent comes together to solve some of the most complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing.

Are you passionate about hands-on technical work and eager to be part of a team that is shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing? Intel is seeking a Manufacturing Equipment Technician (MTE) - Front End Nights Shift - Shift 4 to join our Advanced Packaging Technology Development team in Chandler, Arizona. In this role, you will be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, ensuring the reliability and performance of advanced electromechanical systems used in semiconductor production. You will perform critical maintenance, troubleshooting, and calibration activities that directly impact Intel's production efficiency and technological advancement. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your technical career within a world-class organization that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration.

Shift Hours: Employees working Shift 4 (Sun-Tues and alternating Saturday nights) start their shift at 6:00 PM and finish at 6:30 AM.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to diagnose and resolve issues with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Execute setup, calibration, corrective, and preventative maintenance on production equipment, including wet chemistry, plating, and dry high-vacuum toolsets.
  • Monitor tool performance and analyze equipment data to proactively identify and address issues before they impact production.
  • Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional support teams to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and drive operational excellence.
  • Document maintenance activities, repair findings, and parts usage accurately using established systems and procedures.
  • Lead or contribute to continuous improvement projects, focusing on equipment optimization, yield enhancements, and process efficiency.
  • Support cleanroom operations while strictly adhering to safety protocols and maintaining full cleanroom attire at all times.

As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring:

  • Collaborative Spirit – You thrive in team environments and build strong working relationships across engineering and operations teams.
  • Analytical Thinking – You approach problems with curiosity and a methodical mindset, always seeking the root cause.
  • Clear Communication – You express ideas confidently, both verbally and in writing, ensuring alignment across teams.
  • Adaptability – You embrace change and remain effective in a fast-paced, evolving manufacturing environment.
  • Attention to Detail – You take pride in precision and accuracy, whether documenting findings or executing maintenance procedures.
  • Growth Mindset – You are committed to continuous learning and actively seek opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.
  • Time Management – You prioritize effectively, managing multiple tasks without compromising quality or safety.

Ready to make your mark on the future of semiconductor technology? Apply today and join a team of innovators at Intel's Arizona campus who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible. title: Intel Foundry Module Development Engineer – Advanced Wet Etch and Cleans
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Shape the Atomic Frontier of Semiconductor Innovation

At Intel Foundry Technology and Development (TD), we don't just participate in technology development; we engineer physical reality at the angstrom scale. We are seeking visionary, research-driven Ph.D. graduates in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Electrochemistry, and Engineering to spearhead the next breakthrough in semiconductor manufacturing.

As a Wet Etch Module Development Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of fundamental chemical kinetics, interfacial surface science, and high-volume manufacturing engineering. You will pioneer atomic-layer selective etching, nanoscale surface cleans, supercritical and surface-tension-engineered drying, wet chemical formulations, and advanced single-wafer wet tool architectures to define the future of global computing.

What You Will Do:

  • Pioneer Next-Gen Process Architectures: Formulate and execute rigorous Design of Experiments (DOE) to invent, characterize, and validate novel wet etch, selective removal, and advanced chemical clean processes that power world-class transistor architectures (RibbonFET/GAA), backside power delivery networks (PowerVia), and high-density interconnect scaling
  • Lead Hardware and Module Co-Optimization: Collaborate with premier global semiconductor equipment suppliers and specialty chemical vendors to push single-wafer and batch wet processing capabilities beyond conventional fluid-dynamic and surface-tension limits, co-engineering custom dispense, megasonic, and chamber hardware solutions
  • Harness AI and Scientific Computing: Integrate computational fluid dynamics (CFD), chemical kinetics modeling, statistical physics, and data science (Python, MATLAB, JMP, ML frameworks) to accelerate chemical formulation screening, surface defectivity reduction, and line-yield enhancement
  • Drive High-Impact IP: Translate complex chemical, electrochemical, and surface phenomena into high-value patents, trade secrets, and proprietary wet processing solutions that sustain Intel Foundry's technological leadership
  • Scale Science to Global Manufacturing: Bridge early lab prototypes and coupon-level studies to 300mm fab-scale ramp, seamlessly deploying high-throughput, defect-free wet processes across Intel's worldwide mega-fabs using our industry-leading Copy Exactly (CE) methodology

Why Join Intel Foundry TD?

  • Access to Unparalleled Technology: Direct, hands-on access to the industry's most advanced 300mm cleanroom facilities, state-of-the-art single-wafer wet processing platforms, and cutting-edge analytical surface characterization suites
  • Academic Rigor Meets Global Impact: The intellectual curiosity and depth of doctoral research combined with the scale, capital resources, and execution speed of an industry leader
  • Accelerated Technical Leadership: Direct mentorship and collaboration with Intel Fellows and Senior Principal Engineers on an accelerated path toward technical distinction
  • Comprehensive Total Rewards: Top-tier Ph.D. compensation packages, sign-on bonuses, annual performance bonuses, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), equity/RSU grants, and full relocation assistance

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science and Engineering, Electrochemistry, Mechanical Engineering (Microfluidics/Transport Phenomena), Physics, or a closely related discipline (Degree completed or expected within 12 months)
  • 2+ years of hands-on experimental research experience (e.g., doctoral dissertation, advanced wet chemical synthesis/etching, aqueous/non-aqueous solution chemistry, electrochemistry, surface functionalization, thin-film interface phenomena, or cleanroom wet bench processing)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated deep expertise in chemical reaction kinetics, selective wet etching, interfacial surface chemistry, corrosion/passivation mechanisms, or surfactant-assisted cleaning/drying mechanisms (e.g., Marangoni drying, supercritical (CO2), Surface modification (SMT))
  • Hands-on experience with advanced thin-film, surface, and chemical characterization techniques (e.g., Ellipsometry, AFM, SEM/TEM, XPS, contact angle goniometry, FTIR, TXRF, or ICP-MS)
  • Experience with automated fluidic systems, wet processing instrumentation design, single-wafer spin hardware, or experimental fluid dynamics/mass-transfer troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated experience utilizing Python, MATLAB, JMP, or Machine Learning for design of experiments (DOE), multivariate statistical analysis, or process automation
  • Strong publication record, conference presentations, or filed patent applications demonstrating systematic problem-solving in experimental chemical and materials science

title: NPI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

We are seeking experienced and highly driven individuals to support the Penang Assembly and Test Manufacturing facility as a New Product Integrator. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing New Product Introduction (NPI) activities to ensure successful product startup from engineering builds through high volume manufacturing (HVM). Responsibilities / Expectations • Plan and manage NPI execution activities as a product integrator, supporting the development, implementation, and ramp of new technologies or products for external customers. • Act as the primary coordination point for NPI build execution, engaging cross functional teams across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain to enable successful product startup. • Develop and manage detailed NPI execution plans, including task identification, dependency definition, effort and duration estimation, and project schedule tracking. • Track and publish Performance Against Schedule, ensuring achievement of Critical Success Indicators (CSIs) across key NPI milestones, including: o Recipe Check Out o Power On o Engineering Sample o Quality Sample o Factory Certification o Manufacturing Validation • Ensure manufacturing readiness by coordinating system setup, process flow definition, material readiness, and capacity availability to support NPI builds and data collection. • Understand product and process challenges and work closely with technical experts across multiple groups to identify solutions and drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) alignment during NPI execution. • Proactively identify improvement opportunities and support improvement actions to enhance NPI delivery effectiveness, predictability, and quality. • Lead investigation of issues impacting NPI deliverables, perform structured root cause analysis, align risk mitigation actions, and coordinate resolution with responsible functional owners. • Follow up on recovery actions to ensure NPI schedules and sample volume commitments are met with acceptable quality. • Document NPI readiness and deliverables, including process flow, build routing, BOM, and qualification artifacts, and support preparation of factory certification qualification documentation.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical field. • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing, technology transfer, or related engineering roles. • Knowledge of Assembly and/or Test processes, TD transfer methodologies, and statistical data analysis. • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross functional teams. • Good English verbal and written communication skills. • Ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organizational and project coordination skills. • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.

title: AI Model Optimization Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact

Intel is seeking an AI Model Performance Optimization Engineer to help deliver high-performance AI solutions that enable the next generation of client computing experiences. In this role, you will enable, validate, benchmark, optimize, and debug AI models to ensure they run efficiently and accurately across Intel hardware platforms.

Working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning frameworks, software engineering, and hardware acceleration, you will collaborate with engineers across Intel to improve AI model performance, scalability, and adoption by customers and partners worldwide.

This is an exciting opportunity for engineers passionate about Generative AI, machine learning systems, model optimization, and performance engineering who want to influence technologies used by millions of people globally.

What You Will Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Enable, validate, benchmark, and optimize AI models on Intel platforms to address customer and market segment needs.
  • Analyze model performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Debug issues across AI frameworks, software stacks, and hardware platforms.
  • Develop and execute tests to ensure model functionality, accuracy, and performance.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, compiler, and architecture teams to solve technical challenges.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.
  • Contribute code, bug fixes, documentation, and test coverage to internal and open-source projects.
  • Work effectively with globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and share technical expertise across the team.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: Demonstrates a passion for learning emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and development methodologies.
  • Problem Solving: Approaches complex technical challenges with structured analysis and creative thinking.
  • Ownership: Takes initiative, drives issues to resolution, and delivers high-quality results with accountability.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across software, hardware, architecture, and product teams to achieve shared objectives.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in fast-paced environments where priorities and technologies evolve rapidly.
  • Communication: Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Global Teamwork: Works effectively across geographically distributed teams and diverse perspectives.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 

  • See  Intel Benefits for more details. 

Qualifications:

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Bachelor's degree in a Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline with 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI frameworks, algorithms, and programming OR Master's degree in the same field with 2+ years of experience.

Your experience described above must be in the following

  • Programming in Python and/or C++.
  • Experience with machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Performance analysis, profiling and optimization.
  • Working knowledge of Git-based collaborative development and pull-request workflows.
  • Basic understanding of computer architecture and operating systems.

  • Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience with GenAI models (LLM, VLM, VLA) or OpenVINO.
  • Understanding of parallel programming, preferably with experience in SYCL or OpenCL.
  • Previous publications or contributions to AI research.
  • Familiarity with OpenVINO or other AI inference frameworks.

At Intel, you'll help shape the future of AI by developing technologies that improve the performance and efficiency of AI applications used worldwide. title: CPU Senior Floor Plan Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact Defines the physical dimensions of the CPU IP with consideration for overall product costs such as die size optimization, die per reticle/good die per wafer maximization, and right technology selection as it pertains to metal layers and reuse strategy across different SKUs in a product family. Performs integration of all dies in a package and completes the relevant checks before tape out. Creates and physical database for the IP. Collaborates with architects to optimize the placement of IPs for latency as well as die area/aspect ratio. Creates specifications and collaterals for the IP blocks to execute the floorplan and automatic place and route (APR) at subsequent hierarchies. Collaborates with the clock design and logic design teams to deliver the physical block level floorplans for APR. Collaborates with the power delivery team on tradeoffs for metal allocation for signal and power. Business group You will join Intel Corporation's team focused on CPU design and development, contributing to the creation of groundbreaking technologies that enable world-class computing solutions. This group thrives on innovation, delivering high-performance designs that support Intel's mission to shape the future of technology through the creation of industry-leading products. Key Responsibilities In this role you will be responsible for all the aspects of Floorplan and pin placement activities. You will engage with Architecture, DFT and package to arrive at optimal chip planning early in the design cycle. You will work closely with physical design cluster leads to comprehend design challenges and arrive at optimal floorplan. You will play critical role in die size estimation and in evaluating Floorplan tools, methods and flows. Planning boundaries and pin densities to facilitate high confidence timing closure and routability. title: CPU Senior Floor Plan Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact Defines the physical dimensions of the CPU IP with consideration for overall product costs such as die size optimization, die per reticle/good die per wafer maximization, and right technology selection as it pertains to metal layers and reuse strategy across different SKUs in a product family. Performs integration of all dies in a package and completes the relevant checks before tape out. Creates and physical database for the IP. Collaborates with architects to optimize the placement of IPs for latency as well as die area/aspect ratio. Creates specifications and collaterals for the IP blocks to execute the floorplan and automatic place and route (APR) at subsequent hierarchies. Collaborates with the clock design and logic design teams to deliver the physical block level floorplans for APR. Collaborates with the power delivery team on tradeoffs for metal allocation for signal and power. Business group You will join Intel Corporation's team focused on CPU design and development, contributing to the creation of groundbreaking technologies that enable world-class computing solutions. This group thrives on innovation, delivering high-performance designs that support Intel's mission to shape the future of technology through the creation of industry-leading products. Key Responsibilities In this role you will be responsible for all the aspects of Floorplan and pin placement activities. You will engage with Architecture, DFT and package to arrive at optimal chip planning early in the design cycle. You will work closely with physical design cluster leads to comprehend design challenges and arrive at optimal floorplan. You will play critical role in die size estimation and in evaluating Floorplan tools, methods and flows. Planning boundaries and pin densities to facilitate high confidence timing closure and routability. With your broad understanding of physical design you will play a critical role in identifying and solving multitude design issues at partition/cluster and full chip. Expertise with multiple aspects of ASIC integration including Floorplanning, Clock and Power distribution, global signal planning, I-O planning and hard IP integration.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent education, with 3+ years of hands-on experience OR Master's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of hands-on experience. - Proven expertise in using Floor planning, APR flows, Physical Design Verification Flows using Synopsys or Cadence tools. - Proficiency in hierarchical design approach, top-down design, budgeting, timing and physical convergence. - Strong knowledge of submicron process nodes and layout verification methodologies such as LVS and DRC. - Experience at handling IP/partition/block with multiple voltage and clock domains, ESD strategies, mixed signal block integration, and advanced package technologies. Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, or Python for automation in physical design workflows. - Effective communication skills for collaboration across multidisciplinary teams. - Proven ability to work in dynamic and cross-geographical environments. - Knowledge of feature feasibility studies and advanced design flow methodologies. Contribute to groundbreaking advancements in CPU design and innovation by joining Intel Corporation. Take the next step to shape the future of technology-apply now.

descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation across computing, connectivity, and manufacturing. With a legacy of technological excellence and a bold vision for the future, Intel is committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible — from the chip to the cloud. Our Advanced Packaging Technology Development – Substrate and Wafer Assembly (ATPD: SWA) organization is at the forefront of delivering innovative, cost-effective packaging solutions that power the next generation of technology. At Intel, we believe in investing in our people, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and empowering every team member to make a meaningful impact.

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Manufacturing Equipment Technician to join our ATPD: SWA team in Arizona. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing advanced electromechanical equipment that is critical to Intel's semiconductor manufacturing operations. Your work will directly contribute to Intel's manufacturing innovation, production efficiency, and global competitiveness. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in a world-class cleanroom environment while growing your technical career at one of the most recognized names in the semiconductor industry.

Shift Information

This role operates on Shift 7: 6:00 AM – 6:18 PM on an alternating weekly schedule:

Alternating 3-Day (Thu/Fri/Sat) and 4-Day (Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat) work weeks

Key Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve electrical and mechanical issues across a range of advanced manufacturing equipment.
  • Perform equipment setup, calibration, and both corrective and preventive maintenance, with a focus on wet chemistry, plating, and dry high-vacuum toolsets.
  • Analyze tool performance data to proactively identify and address reliability issues, ensuring minimal production downtime.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional support teams to enhance equipment functionality and streamline manufacturing processes.
  • Accurately document maintenance activities, repair findings, and parts usage in accordance with established systems and protocols.
  • Lead or actively support continuous improvement projects, including root cause analysis and equipment optimization initiatives.

  • Strong communicator — You express ideas clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing, and can work effectively with peers and engineering teams.
  • Collaborative mindset — You thrive in team environments and build strong working relationships across functions.
  • Problem-solving orientation — You approach challenges with curiosity and persistence, always looking for the root cause.
  • Attention to detail — You take pride in accuracy, whether documenting maintenance records or calibrating sensitive equipment.
  • Adaptability — You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced manufacturing environment and embrace change.
  • Continuous improvement mindset — You are proactive in identifying opportunities to improve processes and equipment performance.
  • Accountability — You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments.

Are you ready to be part of a team that is shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing? At Intel in Arizona, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most advanced manufacturing technologies in the world, grow your skills, and make a real impact every day.

Intel's Epoxy MEOS team in Arizona is looking for a Packaging Module Development Engineer to join our growing team of packaging technology experts. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing and optimizing cutting-edge assembly and packaging processes that directly influence the quality, reliability, and performance of Intel's next-generation semiconductor products.

title: Business Development Lead, Neuromorphic Computing
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Opportunity Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab is moving from a highly successful research program into a new phase focused on commercial products and customer deployment. Building on nearly a decade of innovation in Loihi neuromorphic processors and a broad global research ecosystem, the team is developing new computing architectures for AI systems that must perceive, reason, and act in the physical world. Our group reports into Intel's Corporate Technology Office (CTO), a hub for innovation and strategic leadership at Intel, and combines the DNA of a startup with Intel's technology, manufacturing capabilities, and scale.
